name: Lahiguera (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lahiguera (a fig tree on white, a castle and a cross of Calatrava).
history: Municipal flag of Lahiguera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Lahiguera arms — fig tree on white, castle and cross of Calatrava
